question: According to Global MPI 2021, India's rank is ________ out of 109 countries.
solution:
The correct answer is __**66**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2021, India's rank is **66th out of 109 countries**. 
 
• The **MPI measures poverty through various indicators**,
 
 
• assessing factors such as health, education, and living standards to provide a more comprehensive understanding of poverty beyond just income levels.
 
 
 
• The report indicated that India has made significant progress in reducing multidimensional poverty, particularly in the years leading up to the pandemic.
 
• The MPI report showed that **approximately 228 million people** in India were multidimensionally poor as of the 2021 assessment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) is a comprehensive measure developed to assess poverty across multiple dimensions rather than relying solely on income levels.
 
• It was developed by the Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI) and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).
 
• The MPI score is calculated using the formula:
 
 
• MPI=Poverty Headcount Ratio × Intensity of Poverty
